name: Tiki
description: A loud, jovial man in his mid forties who hosts the patio tiki bar and sings exotica and surf-lounge numbers, the life of the party.
build: A stocky, round-bellied man's build: broad shoulders, a big rounded belly, thick arms and sturdy legs of ordinary length, standing upright.
face: Warm tan skin, dark brown eyes under thick black brows, a broad nose, full cheeks, a short dark goatee, a wide mouth.
hair: Thick wavy black hair swept back from the forehead, collar length at the back, clear of the ears.
outfit: A loose short-sleeved aloha shirt in bright turquoise with big bold yellow hibiscus blooms and large white leaves, open at the collar and untucked; a thick lei of large orange and yellow flowers around the neck, resting on the chest; khaki cargo shorts to the knee; tan leather sandals. His head is bare.
performance_style: Broad and welcoming: feet shoulder-width apart, weight settled on both sandals. Both arms hang at the sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, every finger visible beside the thighs. Head level, a wide open-mouthed host's laugh.
location: A backyard patio tiki bar at dusk: a bamboo counter with a thatched roof, glowing tiki torches, a flagstone patio running to the bottom of the frame, a plastic kiddie pool and a lawn beyond, and string lights with paper lanterns overhead.
recognition_cues: a turquoise aloha shirt with big yellow hibiscus blooms
a round belly and swept-back black hair
avoid: a drink or tray in the hands: his hands are empty

sing.intent: Exotica lounge vocal loop: rock the hips side to side, bring the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, sweep the character-left hand in a slow wave out at chest height, then return to the broad stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief start at a loud backyard sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then he settles back to the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: set the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: shimmy in with a hip-swinging step, spread both open hands in welcome and settle into the broad stance.
